// GREEN fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the lint MUST admit this.
// Every PII-carrying field is #[personal_data(...)]-tagged, so the crypto-shred erase and the
// RoPA/data-map fan-out reach it. Non-PII fields (`id`, `region`) need no tag.
pub struct Principal {
    pub id: PrincipalId,
    #[personal_data(contact)]
    pub email: String,
    #[personal_data(identity)]
    pub display_name: String,
    pub region: Region,
}
